findings.observed: The current-source proof now rests entirely on the empty-vault probe: in source-flip test 2 (slugs listed with the vault path emptied equal a baseline read) and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (each consumer's output with only '02 - Sales & Hit List' emptied equals the current output). No code in these files, and no published evidence (one-line commit message; the manifest records only typecheck; no report on disk), shows that the probe catches the defect it exists for: a consumer still discovering prospects from the vault. If the probe did not actually remove vault prospect discovery (a wrong directory name, a symlinked prospect dir, or a reader that ignores ASCEND_VAULT_PATH), every comparison would pass vacuously. CURRENT-SOURCE-AND-CONTROLS requires demonstrating at least one control going red for the intended defect, and FOCUSED-CONTROLLED-PROOF requires exact focused results and a post-run clean tree. Neither can be verified from the published object.
